C1203.title: Five Chaos of AI-Generated Images: Deceptive Digital Human Livestream Traps Scam the Elderly
C1203.summary: Online platforms have banned thousands of accounts using AI digital humans to maliciously defraud users. These digital human livestream traps specifically target groups with weaker discernment, such as the elderly, engaging in fraudulent activities and becoming one of the online chaos.
